 Home News Local News Once Upon a Farm Recalls Toddler Bars Over Choking Risk Once Upon a Farm Recalls Toddler Bars Over Choking Risk
 Tue, November 10, 2026 by Dylan Clark 
 SHARE NOW 
 Once Upon a Farm is recalling all lots and varieties of its Tractor Wheels Organic Toddler Soft-Baked Bars because of a potential choking hazard.
 The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) says the bars can form a dense, sticky mass when chewed, potentially blocking a toddler’s airway. Reports involve children ages 1.5 to 2.5, with some incidents requiring emergency response and hospital observation.
 The products were sold online and in stores nationwide, including Illinois and Puerto Rico. The recall includes all flavors, package sizes and lot codes, including expired products that families may still have at home. Unexpired products have Best If Used By dates ranging from October 30, 2026, through August 26, 2027.
 The company says the recall followed 3 choking complaints reported to the FDA. No injuries were reported in the company’s announcement. Once Upon a Farm is working with the agency to remove affected products while reformulating the bars.
 Consumers should stop using the recalled bars and return them to the place of purchase for a full refund or throw them away. The FDA advises families not to buy or serve any recalled Tractor Wheels products.
 For additional questions, email [email protected] or call 1-888-983-1606 . Customer service hours are Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 6:30 PM and Saturday from 10 AM to 1 PM, Central Time.
